Import necessary libraries

import pandas as pd  
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  
import seaborn as sns  

Next, we are going to load the dataset from the given URL (The Palmer Penguin Dataset)

url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pic16b-ucla/24W/main/datasets/palmer_penguins.csv"
penguins = pd.read_csv(url)

Now, we will add labels, titels, and a legend to the plot

plt.title('Flipper Length vs. Body Mass in Penguins', fontsize=14)  
plt.xlabel('Flipper Length (mm)', fontsize=12)  
plt.ylabel('Body Mass (g)', fontsize=12) 
plt.legend(title='Species')  
plt.grid(alpha=0.3)  

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

C:\Users\sayhi\AppData\Local\Temp\ipykernel_21920\530881654.py:4: UserWarning: No artists with labels found to put in legend.  Note that artists whose label start with an underscore are ignored when legend() is called with no argument.
  plt.legend(title='Species')









Now, we are going to use Seaborn to create a scatter plot. On the x-axis, we will plot Flipper Length (mm) and we will plot Body Mass (g) on the y-axis

sns.scatterplot(data=penguins, x='Flipper Length (mm)', y='Body Mass (g)', hue='Species', alpha=0.7)
